text:
sophie: Customer ACME (acct: acme-123) says console shows $150 trial credits but their consumption via the API is being billed with no credits applied. They hit this while testing embeddings.
eli: Can you paste repro steps + customer-org id? Also include the API response they see.
sophie: Steps from customer:
1) Create account via signup flow (trial auto-grant)
2) Use API key to call embeddings endpoint
3) Check Console -> Billing -> Credits shows $150 available
4) Call GET /v1/usage?range=30d and see no credits applied to usage
Customer sent this curl response (redacted keys):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/billing/usage?start=2026-02-01&end=2026-02-28
{
  "account_id": "acme-123",
  "total_usage_units": 120000,
  "credits_applied": 0,
  "credits_balance_console": 150.00
}
```
eli: Hmm. Two possibilities: promo grant didn't write to billing ledger or it wrote to console-only metadata. @karen-ops can you check the promo-sync job around the customer's signup time?
karen-ops: Checking logs quickly — I see the promo ingestion job for 2026-02-02 failed with a 502 from promo-service for a short window. I can paste snippet:
```
[2026-02-02T03:14:22Z] promo-sync ERROR 502 BadGateway "upstream returned no body" txn=pl-9823
[2026-02-02T03:14:23Z] promo-sync INFO retrying txn=pl-9823 attempt=2
[2026-02-02T03:14:27Z] promo-sync ERROR PermanentFailure txn=pl-9823 "invalid payload"
```
karen-ops: That timeframe matches the customer's signup. Looks like console grant succeeded (frontend write to account metadata) but the ledger entry (billing_credits table) didn't get a row.
eli: @raj-pm any product changes recently that could cause console -> ledger decoupling? raj-pm: We rolled a change to separate front-end visible grants from ledger writes (to allow staged grant visibility) — there was supposed to be a fallback job to reconcile, but maybe it didn't run for that window.
eli: Can you run a quick SQL to check for missing ledger row?
eli: Example query I use:
```
SELECT * FROM billing_credits WHERE account_id = 'acme-123' AND grant_type = 'trial' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
```
sophie: Running it now (from support read-only replica) — returns 0 rows.
eli: Ok confirmed missing. Two short-term options:
- Manually credit the ledger for the customer (support action)
- Trigger the reconciliation job to reprocess the grant queue for that date range
karen-ops: Reconciliation job currently stuck due to the earlier error state on job queue. I can manually re-enqueue txn pl-9823 and run. Will do if support approves.
support-bot: Created internal ticket SUP-2026-487 for ACME credit mismatch and linked to eng-billing. https://redwood.internal/t/SUP-2026-487
sophie: Customer asked for ETA and a temporary fix. I'll offer manual ledger credit and note it's reversible.
eli: @karen-ops please proceed to re-enqueue the txn and re-run reconciliation; also apply manual ledger credit of $150 as a stop-gap, log action.
karen-ops: Ack. Manual ledger insert example (ops-only):
```
INSERT INTO billing_credits (account_id, amount, grant_type, created_by, created_at)
VALUES ('acme-123', 150.00, 'trial', 'support:sophie', now());
```
karen-ops: Done — inserted row and re-enqueued pl-9823. Reconcile job ran and returned success for txn pl-9823.
billing-bot: Ledger update: credits +150.00 applied to acme-123. New ledger_balance: 150.00. Reconcile job status: SUCCESS.
sophie: Told customer we've applied the ledger credit and reprocessed the grant. They confirmed they now see credits deducted when calling usage endpoint.
eli: Follow-ups: we need to add alerting for promo-sync job failures and add a reconcile retry for permanent-failure with human review link. Filing follow-up ticket ENG-2026-912.
raj-pm: I'll prioritize the alert and a dashboard widget in next sprint. Also we'll add a small banner in the console for grants pending ledger confirmation.
sophie: Closing thread with customer notified and ticket SUP-2026-487 linked. Marking as resolved from support side :white_check_mark:
support-bot: SUP-2026-487 status -> Resolved (credits applied).
